definition.common399: 399 syllable types, before auxiliary code. Singleton/affected rates use 399 denominator; frequency-weighted non-first leaves only each bucket highest-frequency syllable first. Not a Hanzi collision rate.
definition.tracks: Canonical early-exit routing, each own fixed robust policy. Frequency-weighted residual non-first after 0,1,2 auxiliaries; word3 also after 3. Denominator always original track total frequency, not the surviving subset. word2 and word4 share a candidate pool. Final level equals selectionRate, earlier levels equal next auxiliary reach rates. Not all members of a colliding bucket.
definition.modes: keytao: shape auxiliaries; sanpin: tone auxiliaries for words, tone then shape for single characters. Both retain toneKeysByTone IVUAO / shapeKeysByMeaning AVUIO / paired invariant 42310.
